## Highlight a token by regex

````markdown
```{{r}}
#| code-style:
#|   - hi: { line: 4, match: "summarise" }
```
````

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
#| code-style:
#|   - hi: { line: 4, match: "summarise" }
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## Highlight by column range

Columns are 1-indexed and inclusive on both ends.

````markdown
```{{r}}
#| code-style:
#|   - hi: { line: 4, cols: 3-12 }
```
````

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
#| code-style:
#|   - hi: { line: 4, cols: 3-12 }
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## Combine line and token

Line-level emphasis plus a token call-out on top.

````markdown
```{{r}}
#| code-style:
#|   styles:
#|     bug: { bg: "#ffd4d4", outline: "1px solid #c00" }
#|   steps:
#|     - dim: 1-3
#|       focus: 4
#|       bug: { line: 4, match: "mean\\(mpg\\)" }
#|     - dim: [1-3, 5]
#|       focus: 4
```
````

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
#| code-style:
#|   styles:
#|     bug: { bg: "#ffd4d4", outline: "1px solid #c00" }
#|   steps:
#|     - dim: 1-3
#|       focus: 4
#|       bug: { line: 4, match: "mean\\(mpg\\)" }
#|     - dim: [1-3, 5]
#|       focus: 4
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```
